Res.Caption: Direction
Res.FullDescription: The Free Days is applied if this Direction matches the Consolidation's Direction.

Res.Caption: Container Type/Class
Res.FullDescription: The Free Days is applied if this Class matches the Consolidation's Container Type.

Res.Caption: Penalty Port/Country/Region
Res.FullDescription: The Free Days is applied if this port/country/region matches the consolidations last POD or first POL. (Place of Acceptance for exports, Discharge for imports).

Res.Caption: Free Days
Res.FullDescription: Number of free days that applies.

Res.Caption: Carrier
Res.FullDescription: The Free Days is applied if this Carrier matches the Consolidation's Carrier.

Res.Caption: CTO
Res.FullDescription: The Free Days is applied if this CTO matches the Consolidation's Arrival or Departure CTO Address.

Res.Caption: Client
Res.FullDescription: The Free Days is applied if this Client matches the Shipment's Consignee or Consignor. This client is responsible for paying the penalty fee.

Res.Caption: Load Port/Country/Region
Res.FullDescription: The load port / country / region that this detention setting applies to.

Res.Caption: 1st/Last Free Day
Res.FullDescription: The available date used to calculate the return required by date.

Res.Caption: Creditor/Storage Due
Res.FullDescription: The organization that the penalty is due to.

Res.Caption: Free Day Exclusions
Res.FullDescription: The days excluded when calculating Free Days.

Res.Caption: Duration Exclusions
Res.FullDescription: The days excluded when calculating Duration.
